Device
 
 
Warning: this saves keys in plain text in this browser's localStorage. Anyone who can use this browser profile can read them. Don't use it on shared workstations.

 
Auto-clear saved draft

 
Entered text (both panes, dictation transcript, AI note, patient name/MRN, MA label, Document ID, always-remove list) is saved in this browser's storage so a refresh or relaunch doesn't lose it. It stays until you tap Clear all (or the auto-clear time above). Audio and scanned images are never saved: a recording in progress, held audio and scanned pages are lost on refresh. HIPAA: use this only on a device with a passcode/login and disk encryption (FileVault, iOS passcode).









Before you send to 


  • Consumer ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity accounts generally have no BAA (business associate agreement). Do not treat them as HIPAA-covered.
    • 

  • De-identification here is rule-based, not certified (not an expert determination). It can miss things. Read the text before you send it.
    • 

  • Only the de-identified text is copied. A second check runs first and blocks the send if names, dates of birth, record numbers or phone numbers are still found.
    • 

  • Turn off model training / history in each account:
      

    • ChatGPT: Settings → Data controls → turn off "Improve the model for everyone". OpenAI help
      • 

    • Gemini: turn off "Keep Activity". Gemini Apps Activity · Privacy Hub
      • 

    • Grok: Settings → Data → turn off "Improve the Model" (app: Settings → Data Controls). xAI FAQ
      • 

    • Perplexity: Account settings → Preferences → turn off "AI data retention". Perplexity help
